text:
ivan_perez: Hey team — our org's credit balance suddenly dropped to 0 right at 00:00 UTC. Dashboard shows 0 remaining but the invoice/ledger still lists the free-tier grant. Not sure if this is an expired promo or a bug. Screenshot: https://redwood.screens/secure/abc123.png

jessica_lee: sorry to hear that — can you paste the org id and the exact timestamps you saw the drop? did you have any promo codes applied previously?

ivan_perez: org_9fz3b — we never had a promo code. Drop happened ~2026-03-10T00:00:12Z. We were running heavy batch embeddings between 23:45-23:59 UTC (spike ~1.2M tokens). here's the credit API I hit:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/org_9fz3b/credits"
```
response at 00:00:15Z: `{"available":0, "reserved":0, "pending_expiry":0}`

mike_billing: I can see a `credit-reset` cleanup job ran at 00:00:00 UTC and it removed some entitlements. It should only remove promos with explicit expiry, not the free-tier entitlement. can you also paste a GET /v1/usage?as_of=2026-03-10T00:00Z output (redact tokens if needed).

ivan_perez: pasted minimal usage: `{"org_id":"org_9fz3b", "window_start":"2026-03-09T23:00:00Z", "window_end":"2026-03-10T00:00:00Z", "tokens_consumed":1234567}` — nothing about promos. Also ran `GET /v1/credits?scope=org`: returned available 0.

sam_kim: possible race between ingestion pipeline (writes usage) and ledger reapply job. can you repro quickly: 1) call a small /v1/generate to consume ~100 tokens 2) immediately `GET /v1/orgs/org_9fz3b/credits` — paste both responses. curl snippets: 
```bash
# generate
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"rwd-mini","input":"test","max_tokens":50}'
# check credits
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/org_9fz3b/credits
```

ivan_perez: ran it now. Generate response headers: `X-Credits-Consumed: 150`. Immediately after GET credits showed `{"available":0, "reserved":0}` — so consumption recorded but balance didn't decrement (it went to 0).

mike_billing: thanks — that confirms mismatch between usage ingestion and ledger applied deltas. I'm escalating to billing infra. temporary workaround: I've re-applied the org's free-tier credit (1000 units) and forced a ledger refresh for org_9fz3b. It should appear in the dashboard within 5 minutes. (escalation id: BILL-2026-4107) :white_check_mark:

ivan_perez: confirmed after ~3m dashboard shows available 1000 again. Huge help, thanks. We'll keep monitoring overnight.

jessica_lee: i've added a short ticket to product backlog: `ensure ledger apply is idempotent and add stronger sequence watermarking` — linking BILL-2026-4107.

sam_kim: follow-up action for eng-infra: add a short-circuit check so ledger won't zero-out free-tier grants when ingestion lag > 30s. filing infra ticket.

ivan_perez: great — thanks everyone. tagging for visibility @billing-bot if you want to auto-track this in the billing incident board.

billing-bot: Incident BILL-2026-4107 created and linked to support thread. Assigned to mike_billing.

ivan_perez: closing this thread on our side — will re-open if we see reoccurrence. thanks again!
